reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL
reviews.text: Very nourishing lip balm. It has a thick but comfortable texture which means the moisturised feeling lasts a long time. There is no scent. I would definitely buy this again!
reviews.zh: 非常滋潤嘅潤唇膏。質地厚但舒服，所以保濕感覺可以維持好耐。冇香味。一定會回購！

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL
reviews.text: So very disappointed. I was so excited to try this lip balm and within 1 day, it gave me bumps on my lips. I have the other one too with the pink lid, so I’m guessing I will have the same reaction to it :(
reviews.zh: 非常失望。本來好興奮想試呢隻潤唇膏，點知用咗一日就令我嘴唇生晒粒粒。我都有另一隻粉紅色蓋嗰隻，估計都會有同樣反應 :(

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL
reviews.text: Not as great as the Anua lip serum, but a nice alternative to mix it up. This one is a little more slick like petroleum than I prefer
reviews.zh: 冇 Anua 唇部精華咁好，但係一個幾好嘅選擇可以輪住用。呢隻比較似凡士林咁滑，我自己就冇咁鍾意

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL
reviews.text: Luckily I don’t suffer from dry lips because I find most lip balms/ creams uncomfortable to wear. However I tried this lip product because lately weather been pretty icy in the early morning when I going to work and I like Torriden moisturisers and sheet masks so thought to give this a try. It has helped protect and nourish my lips and is actually quite comfortable to wear with no lingering residual greasy heaviness.
reviews.zh: 好彩我冇受唇乾困擾，因為我覺得大部分潤唇膏／唇霜都搽住唔舒服。不過我試咗呢款唇部產品，因為最近朝早返工嘅天氣凍到入骨，而且我鍾意 Torriden 嘅保濕品同面膜，所以想試下。佢幫到我保護同滋潤嘴唇，搽住其實幾舒服，冇殘留嗰種油笠嘅厚重感。

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL
reviews.text: I LIKE IT SOOO MUCH!!!! It keeps my lips moisturized without creating a sticky film. You don't have to reapply it everytime, which is great!!
reviews.zh: 我勁鍾意！！！保持嘴唇保濕又唔會形成黐笠嘅薄膜。唔使成日補搽，呢點好正！！

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL
reviews.text: This lip essence is so moisterizing. I use it alone and it lasts for long. I love the shine it gives! The lips feel hydrated for long!
reviews.zh: 呢支唇部精華非常保濕。我單獨使用，持久度好長。我好鍾意佢帶嚟嘅光澤感！嘴唇長時間都感到水潤！

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL
reviews.text: It feels more like a lip gloss or a balm once applied. I bought this "lip essence" since I was looking for something essence-like or watery in consistency to prime my lips before make up, but my lip pigments don't glide that well after applying this one. It's better to use as a lip sleeping mask.
reviews.zh: 塗上去之後感覺比較似唇彩或者潤唇膏。我買呢支「唇部精華」係因為想搵一支質地似精華或者水狀嘅產品嚟幫化妝前打底唇，但用完呢支之後，我嘅唇部彩妝冇辦法好順滑咁推開。反而用嚟做唇膜比較好。

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL
reviews.text: I have used many "good rating" lip balms. In my experiences, this lip balm had a lasting moisture left on my lips. I'm happy with it.
reviews.zh: 我用過好多「高評分」嘅潤唇膏。根據我嘅經驗，呢支潤唇膏可以喺嘴唇上面keep到長效保濕。我好滿意。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
